companyProductSpec.description: A licensed e-money issuer providing digital payment solutions including e-wallets, payment gateway services, and cross-border remittance for Malaysian consumers and businesses.
companyProductSpec.productDescription: Mobile-first digital wallet application enabling users to store funds, make payments, transfer money, and access financial services. Licensed under BNM e-Money Guidelines.

features.name: Digital Onboarding (e-KYC)
features.description: Allows users to register and verify identity using facial recognition and document scanning without visiting a physical branch.

features.name: Peer-to-Peer Transfer
features.description: Enables instant money transfers between registered users using phone number or QR code.

features.name: Bill Payments
features.description: Allows users to pay utility bills, telco bills, and government services directly from the wallet.

features.name: Cross-Border Remittance
features.description: International money transfer service to selected countries with real-time exchange rates.

features.name: Merchant QR Payments
features.description: DuitNow QR integration allowing users to pay at participating merchants nationwide.

financialOperations.name: Wallet Top-Up
financialOperations.description: Users can add funds to their wallet via bank transfer, debit card, or cash at partner outlets.

financialOperations.name: Cash Withdrawal
financialOperations.description: Users can withdraw cash at partner ATMs and retail outlets.

financialOperations.name: FX Conversion
financialOperations.description: Real-time currency conversion for cross-border transactions at competitive rates.

thirdPartyIntegrations.name: MyKad Verification API (JPN)
thirdPartyIntegrations.purpose: Real-time verification of Malaysian national ID cards during e-KYC onboarding

thirdPartyIntegrations.name: World-Check (Refinitiv)
thirdPartyIntegrations.purpose: PEP and sanctions screening for customer onboarding and ongoing monitoring

thirdPartyIntegrations.name: DuitNow (PayNet)
thirdPartyIntegrations.purpose: Instant payment rails for P2P transfers and merchant payments

thirdPartyIntegrations.name: Wise API
thirdPartyIntegrations.purpose: Cross-border remittance corridor for international transfers

systemArchitecture.frontend: React Native mobile app with Next.js web dashboard
systemArchitecture.backend: Node.js microservices on AWS EKS with Go for high-throughput transaction processing
securityControls: Hardware Security Module (HSM) for key management

knownRisks: High transaction volume may exceed real-time screening capacity during peak periods
Cross-border remittance to high-risk corridors requires enhanced due diligence
E-KYC facial recognition may have reduced accuracy for certain demographics
Agent network cash-out points present higher money mule risk
DuitNow instant payments limit time for fraud detection
